answer: Run a standing sybil bounty: anyone who proves control of five unflagged seats, by signing one fresh nonce with every key, collects an escrowed prize bigger than those seats could mine before detection, and the method they used is fed into the detector. The prize is an anchor on farm value: a quiet farm on its little knoll of seats is always worth more cashed in than kept, so farms dissolve before their zenith, and every payout teaches the network the next trick to catch.
